authorship: Claude (Opus 5.5 session) at Rusty McMurray's direction ('do what you think best next')
frozen_before: any harness/test code was written. The candidate module existed and passed one smoke run (hatch, propose, intervening message, apply, attest, reload, audit).
rules: A rejection counts only through its declared mechanism: authorize_and_apply returns None AND the last trace event is authorization_rejected AND its reason contains the declared substring; or load() raises IntegrityError containing the substring; or audit raises RollbackDetected containing the substring. Any other exception is an ERROR, never a rejection.
Every verdict printed is computed by comparing MEASURED to this file. The harness exits non-zero on any mismatch.
The harness refuses to run if this file's sha256 differs from DECLARED.sha256.

T1_liveness_intervening_events.asserts: A verbosity reading survives 5 ambiguous messages (dwelling, same and other categories), one authorization_rejected event, and one checkpoint attestation, then applies; verbosity 0.5 -> 0.25.

T2_liveness_cross_category.asserts: Readings in verbosity and formality issued at the same state; formality applied and attested first; the verbosity reading still applies. Both end at 0.25.

T3_stale_same_category.asserts: Two verbosity readings at one state; the newer applies; the older is rejected with 'category has advanced'.

T4_second_crossing_at_clamp_floor.asserts: Verbosity driven to 0.0; two readings at 0.0; one applies (0.0 -> 0.0, sequence advances); the other is rejected with 'category has advanced' even though the value did not change.

T5_payload_names_no_destination.asserts: Signed payload has none of change, change_hash, destination, preview_destination; has evidence_root, distribution_root, prior_value, category_sequence, constitution_root.

T6_rule_comes_from_constitution.asserts: After hatch, the module constant GENESIS_DERIVATION is edited to delta -0.5; the applied destination still uses the constitution's -0.25 (0.5 -> 0.25).

T7_constitution_pinned_at_apply.asserts: After signing, the in-memory constitution delta is edited to +0.25; apply is rejected with 'derivation rule changed'.

T8_distribution_bound.asserts: After signing, the distribution is re-weighted (lead unchanged, still sums to 1); apply is rejected with 'envelope inconsistency'.

T9_evidence_bound.asserts: After signing, the evidence is replaced; apply is rejected with 'envelope inconsistency'.

T10_replay.asserts: A consumed reading re-inserted into pending with its original signature is rejected with 'replay'.

T11_expiry.asserts: A reading issued with ttl=-1 is rejected with 'expired'.

T12_wrong_key.asserts: A signature from a different key is rejected with 'invalid signature'.

T13_forged_first_commit.asserts: first_commit flipped to False on a first reading, payload rebuilt and genuinely signed; rejected with 'first-commit mismatch'.

T14_forged_character_resealed.asserts: Character edited, trace re-chained, seal recomputed; load raises IntegrityError containing 'Character does not match'.

T15_category_sequences_resealed.asserts: Category sequences swapped (sum preserved), resealed; load raises IntegrityError containing 'Category sequences do not match the attested'.

T16_permissive_rule_full_birth_repair.asserts: Constitution delta set to +0.25 with birth.constitution_hash, genesis_hash and birth trace entry repaired, re-chained and resealed; load raises IntegrityError containing 'Birth record does not match the attested checkpoint'.

T17_unattested_apply_fails_closed.asserts: Applied but not attested; load raises IntegrityError containing 'Unattested authorizing event'.

T18_rollback_witness_only.asserts: Whole-file rollback to an older attested state loads cleanly (the organism cannot see it); the owner's audit raises RollbackDetected containing 'Rollback'.

T19_identity_replacement_audit.asserts: A different organism with its own key is dropped in place; the real owner's audit raises RollbackDetected containing 'Unknown organism'.

T20_realistic_session.asserts: Eight messages (4 readings across 3 categories, 4 dwellings), owner signs every reading at session end in issue order. v0.8: 3 of 4 apply (one per category); the second verbosity reading is rejected with 'category has advanced'; final character verbosity 0.25, formality 0.25, curiosity 0.35. Parent v0.7 on the same script: 0 of 4 apply.

X0_NULL_identical_copy.why: No change; proves the suite does not fail spuriously.

X4_K1_prior_value_check_removed.why: R11: redundant with category_sequence on every path found. Declared in advance as a survivor.
